confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from an RBA search result: 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. I ran one search for food and drink prices. Crowd-sourced indexes for Naha disagreed with each other, so I used rounded mid-range values. Coffee and inexpensive meal are the best supported. Midrange meal is moderately supported. Beer, cocktail and wine were not directly found for Naha. I set them from typical Japanese izakaya pricing, with cocktail and wine at about 1.3 to 1.5 times the beer price. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, and I did not check listings. Naha is a busy resort and tourist city, so July peak-season rates could be higher.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other regional Japanese cities such as Fukuoka. Naha is cheaper than Tokyo or Osaka for dining, and its accommodation is priced for tourist demand.
